newsitem.title: UK: First Leisure's Grade raises stake in firm.
newsitem.headline: First Leisure's Grade raises stake in firm.

text.p: Britain's First Leisure Corp Plc said on Thursday that chairman Michael Grade bought 27,000 shares in the company at 365p per share.
The purchase raised Grade's total holding to 29,100 shares, representing 0.017 percent of the company's ordinary shares, First Leisure said in a statement to the London Stock Exchange.
First Leisure's shares rose 10p to 369.5 by 1430 GMT.
On Wednesday, Grade, who recently resigned as chief executive of Britain's Channel Four television station, was named executive chairman of the company. He was already non-executive chairman.
